title: Relay Cooldown Score
statement: A relay offers one transmission at each tick, with the signed score recorded in scores. Choose any set of ticks, but never choose two neighboring ticks: every transmission requires the next tick to be idle. Return the greatest total score you can earn. You may choose no ticks, earning zero. The first and last ticks are not neighbors. Preserve the order of the record; negative scores are allowed.
constraints: 1 <= len(scores) <= 100000; -1000000 <= scores[i] <= 1000000. Return an integer; the answer may exceed signed 32-bit range.

examples.explanation: Choose ticks 0 and 2 for 5 + 5 = 10. Choosing only the largest score earns 9.
Choose no ticks rather than accepting a negative total.
Ticks 0 and 3 are compatible. The record is a line, not a ring.

referenceSolution:
def relay_cooldown_score(scores):
    two_back = 0
    one_back = 0
    for score in scores:
        current = max(one_back, two_back + score)
        two_back = one_back
        one_back = current
    return one_back
